cases.oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(amount) AS value_count, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events

SELECT entity_id, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(amount) AS value_count, SUM(amount) AS total FROM events WHERE region = 'North' AND event_date >= DATE '2032-09-01' AND event_date < DATE '2032-10-01' GROUP BY entity_id ORDER BY entity_id

notes: Missing entity E4 and all-NULL E5 are distinct provenance cases. Do not turn either into zero. An INNER-only result is not complete entity-universe coverage. Existing JOIN restrictions must not be relaxed to pass this oracle.
